# Chip (`chip`)

Selectable or removable pill; chip groups and weekday picker.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createChipGroup` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/chip.d.ts`): `.mh-chip-group`: a wrapping row of chips. Selectable chips toggle (`single` keeps at most one pressed);removable chips leave the group with focus kept on a neighbouring chip.

```ts
export function createChipGroup(options: ChipGroupOptions): ChipGroupHandle;

export interface ChipGroupOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label: string;
  chips: readonly ChipItem[];
  /** `multiple` (default) or `single` selection; `none` for static or removable chips. */
  selection?: 'multiple' | 'single' | 'none';
  values?: readonly string[];
  /** Chips carry a remove button (with `selection: 'none'`). */
  removable?: boolean;
  onChange?: (values: string[]) => void;
  /** A chip's remove button was pressed; the chip is removed and focus moves to a neighbour. */
  onRemove?: (value: string) => void;
}

export interface ChipGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getValues(): string[];
  setValues(values: readonly string[]): void;
}

export interface ChipItem {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createChipGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const filter = createChipGroup({
  label: 'Show devices',
  values: ['lights'],
  chips: [
    { value: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb' },
    { value: 'climate', label: 'Climate', icon: 'thermometer' },
    { value: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: 'music' },
    { value: 'fans', label: 'Fans', icon: 'fan' },
  ],
  onChange: (values) => (status.textContent = `Filters: ${values.join(', ') || 'none'}`),
});

document.body.append(filter.el, status);
```

## React API

`ChipGroup` (types in `dist/react/choice-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createChipGroup`.

```ts
export function ChipGroup({ label, chips, selection = 'multiple', values, defaultValues, onChange, removable, onRemove, className }: ChipGroupProps);

export interface ChipGroupProps {
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label: string;
  chips: readonly ChipItem[];
  selection?: 'multiple' | 'single' | 'none';
  values?: readonly string[];
  defaultValues?: readonly string[];
  onChange?: (values: string[]) => void;
  removable?: boolean;
  /** Remove the chip from `chips` in response; focus moves to a neighbouring chip. */
  onRemove?: (value: string) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ChipGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const KINDS = [
  { value: 'lights', label: 'Lights', icon: 'lightbulb' },
  { value: 'climate', label: 'Climate', icon: 'thermometer' },
  { value: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: 'music' },
  { value: 'fans', label: 'Fans', icon: 'fan' },
];

export function ChipExample() {
  const [kinds, setKinds] = useState(['lights']);
  return <ChipGroup label="Show devices" chips={KINDS} values={kinds} onChange={setKinds} />;
}
```
